input.summary:
Clock room (box x19..21, y11..30, z11..13) furnished: clerk's desk (lectern, dark oak stair chair) and barrel with a lit candle on the floor, a clock works of dark oak logs, trapdoors, chain and planks on the back of the north face (z11, y28..30), a lantern on a chain under the belfry floor at x20 z12 for the works, and a chain-hung lantern at x19 z13 for the floor.
make.sh finished with a whole build.nbt. The part line shows 35 placed, with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes. Interior check from a floor cell: all 8 floor cells reachable, min light 10, 0 dark.
Full-building walk still says "no way in" because the front door and vestibule are stubs in this copy; the ladder check (y27..31) waits on the clock-face dressings.

waste.what: Checking walkability: the room tool floods from the building entrance, which is unbuilt here, so I wrote a scratch rooms file (in /tmp) whose entrance is an interior cell to verify my own floor.
waste.cost: 2 extra mcd room runs and a scratch JSON file
waste.tool: mcd room --from <x,y,z> (start the flood at a given cell, or report per-room reachability from the room's own ladder/stair cells)

waste.what: Looking at the room: the 'rooms --out' dollhouse view showed only the roof and chimney above the room, not the room, so I fell back to an eye-level render I had to aim by hand.
waste.tool: mcd rooms --only <room> with an interior cutaway that clips to the room's box (and keeps a cut plane at the room's ceiling)

waste.what: The chain column, pendulum and lantern cells were built by a small loop, one at a time, outside the text grid.
waste.cost: about 17 chain cells set by a loop
waste.tool: layers() for a single column, or a fill helper with a block state (axis) for chain runs

waste.what: Light placement: I placed two lanterns and a candle by reasoning about light falloff, then confirmed with mcd room.
waste.tool: mcd room lantern-spot suggestions as a ready-to-paste layers() legend for the spot

companions.task: Design the clock works behind the north face: which gears, arbors and escapement plates read as a movement from the ladder, and the pendulum's length and where its lantern hangs.
Build the clerk's desk and chair in the west corner as one piece, including the lectern's facing and the reader's spot.

left: Full-building walk verdict is 'no way in' until the front door (fittings) and the vestibule (room 1) are built; my floor is verified only from an interior start cell (all 8 reachable).
mcd check flags the tower ladder at x21 z13 y27..31 as unsupported because the back wall at z14 is still air there; the clock-face and band dressings at z14 should fill it after the merge.

Clock face hands and the works sit only on the north face (z11); the east, south and west works are not in this room (the shaft is 3 wide, so the interior is only 8 floor cells). The belfry part above owns the y31 floor and its ladder hole.
No plan.md checklist or elements.md item is mine to tick (the Clock room is not a listed element), so nothing ticked.
